80981.subject: Jupiter's YOLO Hits $1 Billion in Its First Day
80981.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Jupiter](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/jupiter-says-yolo-hit-1-billion-in-volume-in-under-24-hours)**['s YOLO did $1B in volume in a day](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/jupiter-says-yolo-hit-1-billion-in-volume-in-under-24-hours)

* **[MSCI](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/msci-adopts-rules-putting-strategy-and-metaplanet-at-risk-of-index-removal)**[ may drop Strategy and Metaplanet](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/msci-adopts-rules-putting-strategy-and-metaplanet-at-risk-of-index-removal)

* **[NEAR Intents](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/near-intents-postmortem-links-3-8-million-exploit-to-deposit-bug)**[ published its $3.8M postmortem](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/near-intents-postmortem-links-3-8-million-exploit-to-deposit-bug)

* **[Aave V4](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-v4-s-arc-markets-connect-dollar-euro-loans-to-shared-liquidity)**[ links dollar and euro loans on Arc](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-v4-s-arc-markets-connect-dollar-euro-loans-to-shared-liquidity)

* **[AMC](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/amc-ceo-says-company-won-t-consent-to-robinhood-stock-tokens-in-us)**[ refused Robinhood stock tokens](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/amc-ceo-says-company-won-t-consent-to-robinhood-stock-tokens-in-us)

Every DeFi protocol keeps two records. One is its internal ledger, which says who is owed what. The other is the set of assets it actually holds. While the two match, every balance on the ledger can be redeemed. In the past day, three projects disclosed that their two records had come apart, each in a different way. Is there one check that would have caught all three?

Backbone Labs runs bOSMO, a liquid staking token for Osmosis. Each token stands for OSMO staked on the holder's behalf and can be redeemed for it. Since at least April, the contract [paid about 1.676 OSMO per bOSMO](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/bosmo-bug-leaves-little-backing-prompts-holder-compensation-plan) at redemption. The stated rate was about 1.117. The contract counted OSMO staked with Backbone's own validator twice. On Oct. 9, the Osmosis community pool redeemed 776,000 bOSMO and received about 1.3 million OSMO. That is roughly 433,000 OSMO more than the stated rate allowed. The remaining holders were left with backing of about 0.06 OSMO per token.

NEAR Intents runs cross-chain swaps against an internal ledger on NEAR. An attacker made 23 deposits through a contract built to fail. The token contract refunded each deposit, but the ledger kept the credit. Between Sept. 29 and Oct. 1, the attacker withdrew [$3.8 million](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/near-intents-halts-services-reports-3-8-million-loss) against those credits, and later [returned it in full](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/near-intents-gm-says-3-8-million-in-hack-funds-returned-in-full).
